upstream.description: Kotlin LLM Prompts and User Interface

classification.analysis: PromptFx is a Kotlin prototype for LLM prompt engineering and chaining (the promptkt/promptex libraries) paired with a JavaFX demo UI for testing OpenAI- and Gemini-compatible models: document Q&A/RAG over local PDFs, prompt template/scripting tools, translation/summarization/sentiment views, and image/audio playgrounds. The promptex module adds an execution layer with agent, tool, and pipeline logic plus an MCP server/client. The README explicitly frames it as built for demonstration and exploration rather than production use, aimed at JVM developers experimenting with prompt engineering and RAG patterns outside the Python ecosystem.

use_cases.title: Experiment with prompt templates and chaining in a desktop JVM app
Run local document Q&A over a folder of PDFs
Prototype an MCP server or client from Kotlin
